review_comments: When topsql is disabled, should reset the `ddlJobCtx`, since some internal SQL use will use this context to execute SQL. Reset the `cacheDigest` is just in case.
No, actually `cacheDigest` won't be modified/read in other place, so `cacheDigest` no need to be reset here, but I reset here just in case in the future.
I am concerned about the cost of generating a new `cacheDigest`.
No, normally it won't generating a new `cacheDigest`.   since the job won't be nil normally.
Adding a check for only one kind of SQL smells not good. At least put a comment with the issue number here.
Only from this PR I can't determine the corresponding source of this format (`sqlStr+"--"+req.String()`), can we extract this string concatenation into a function?
